text:
tara: heads up y'all, noticed a regression on Mistral 8x7B sliding-window flows after the last kernel selector tweak. 95p latency up ~18% on short-chained prompts.
ryan: ugh. same jobs/traffic that hit it? any particular sequence length distribution?
tara: mostly sequences 32-128. batching heuristics haven't changed, but kernel selection favored the tiled attention kernel for a bunch of requests.
izzy: tiled kernel should help throughput but might hurt latency for small seqs. did we get a perf profile?
perfbot: perf report available: s3://perf-artifacts/1812345678/mistral-8x7b-run1.html (nvprof + cpu traces)
ryan: skimmed the report — major hotspot in attention kernel when mask is non-trivial (sliding window masks). KV writes spike, and CUDA kernels show reduced occupancy.
izzy: sliding-window masking creates weird memory access patterns. kernel chooser maybe thought it could reuse an optimized path but mask scattering kills coalescing.
tara: also seeing weird KV pointer churn in logs: `kv_ptr` resets for some requests, likely because of max_position_embeddings handling hitting the wrap condition for virtual windowing.
ryan: ah that explains tail latency spikes. If max_pos gets enforced in code path, we flush KV and restart from zero, which is expensive. Are we incorrectly applying `pos % max_pos` vs sliding-window offset?
izzy: code snippet from runtime: ```
if (seq_pos >= config.max_pos) {
  clear_kv_cache();
  seq_pos = seq_pos % config.max_pos;
}
```
ryan: that conditional is fine, but combined with sliding-window mask we may be flipping between two code paths: one that uses KV-hinting and one that does a full reset. Branch misprediction + cache flush = perf regression.
tara: what about RoPE scaling? 8x7B has different head_dim and we scaled by sqrt(2) in the runtime to match older models. Could that change kernel codegen and lead to different memory layout?
izzy: RoPE scaling itself shouldn't change memory layout, but if we change how we pack Q/K to align to warp widths (e.g., pad to 64 bytes) that could. We do have a special-case layout for head_dim % 16 != 0. 8x7b head_dim is 128? need to confirm.
ryan: Mistral 8x7B has head_dim 64 (for some configs) and 7B has 128 in others depending on mixtral variant. mismatch in layout logic means different kernel selected by kernel_estimator.
tara: tangible numbers: when kernel selector picks tiled-attn we see median latency +1.2ms, p95 +6.8ms relative to baseline. When forced to fallback to simple sliding-window kernel, median drops by 0.9ms and tail by ~5ms. throughput slightly down but our SLO favors latency.
izzy: actionable checklist: 1) audit kernel_selector heuristics for sliding-window masks and prefer the mask-safe kernel for seq_len < 256. 2) add a kv-pointer-wrap test in nightly perf to catch resets. 3) confirm head_dim packing rules for 8x7b and avoid layout branching when possible.
ryan: also add a quick patch: when `seq_pos >= max_pos` and request uses sliding-window masking, prefer an incremental move of KV (rotate pointers) instead of full clear. We already have rotate logic but it's gated behind `use_rotated_kv` flag. Maybe toggle it earlier.
tara: I'm pushing a small repro to perf infra now with both kernels and a synthetic trace that mimics our chat workload (many short turns + repeated mask patterns).
izzy: share the reproduce cmd plz.
tara: `./scripts/run_perf.sh --model mistral-8x7b --profile --window 64 --seqs 32,64,128 --mask sliding --kernels tiled,simple --out s3://perf-artifacts/1812345678`
ryan: nice. can we also dump `kv_ptr` and `kv_alloc_map` in the trace? add `--debug-kv` flag.
tara: done. repro running. linking once finished.
perfbot: new artifact uploaded: s3://perf-artifacts/1812345678/repro-v1.tar.gz (contains nvprof, nvtx ranges, kernel selection logs)
izzy: quick look — kernel selection log shows heuristic score heavily weighting `estimated_throughput` but not considering `mask_density`. need to add mask-savvy penalty to the estimator.
ryan: agreed. I'll add a lightweight `mask_cost_estimate(mask_type, avg_window)` function to the estimator. should be cheap and avoid misrouting.
tara: estimate change + unit tests please. Also add a Canary that pins 5% of traffic to the updated heuristic so we can measure real-world impact before full rollout.
izzy: for KV wrap test, I'll add a synthetic that simulates seq_pos incrementing beyond max_pos without full reset and asserts no full-clear events logged.
ryan: timeline?
tara: ryan, can you push the mask-aware kernel selector patch today? izzy + me will add perf tests and canary config. we should have canary in ~48h if no surprises.
ryan: yep, on it.
izzy: cool. one more note — update docs in runtime/notes about head_dim packing and RoPE scaling oddities for Mistral variants to avoid future surprises.
tara: thanks folks. will follow up with canary metrics once repro completes. :thumbsup:
